newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly steady.

text.p: Hard red winter wheat basis bids were mostly steady on Monday and most dealers noted very limited farm sales.
Farmers were busy planting corn and when that is done, they will plant sorghum or soybeans, a Kansas merchandiser said.
"The HRW wheat crop looks pretty good overall. Of course, we still have the major unknown of how much freeze damage there is on the crop," he said.
In the northwest part of Kansas, rain was needed, another merchandiser said.

"The hard red winter wheat crop looks good now. It is getting really dry, if we don't get some rain in the next week or so, it could impact the crop a little bit. Movement was light," the dealer said.
Rain was also needed in the central part of Kansas.
"We got a little bit last night but not enough to do any good," the dealer noted of recent rain.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: K=KCBT May wheat futures. N=KCBT July. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
